eventDetail.scope: This conference serves as a platform to showcase recent advancements and explore emerging and future growth areas across diverse technical and scientific domains. It encourages researchers to develop innovative and efficient techniques. Renowned keynote speakers, with extensive expertise in various fields, inspire participants to further advance research in signal processing and communication engineering. With contributions from numerous experts, the conference helps address future challenges in areas such as Communication, Signal Processing, VLSI and Embedded Systems, Intelligent Computing and Machine Learning, Sustainable Energy Systems, Human-Centric Assistive Technologies, and Intelligent Robotics. We therefore invite leading researchers, engineers, and scientists to submit their work to ICSC 2027 and share their valuable insights with the global scientific community.
